# Synthetic accuracy fixtures

Every fixture in this directory is synthetic, dummy, or generated specifically
for automated privacy testing. Do not add real identity documents, payment
cards, QR payloads, personal photographs, or OCR output.

The two `synthetic_*.png` images contain fictional AI-generated people and no
real identity data. Remaining images are generated at test time from fixed,
non-sensitive constants by `privacy_detection/fixture_factory.py`.
